    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>The <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/canada/" >Canadian men's national team</a> continued a strong start to the September-October international window on Saturday, taking a <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/competitions/international-friendlies/2026/matches/canvsper-10-03-2026/" >2-0 victory</a> over Peru at <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/cf-montreal/" >CF Montréal</a>'s Stade Saputo.</p>

    </div>
  
              </div>
              <div class="body-part d3-l-col__col-12">
                

    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p><a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/players/jacob-shaffelburg/" >Jacob Shaffelburg</a> provided both goals for Jesse Marsch's side, accounting for all the scoring with a first-half brace.</p>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>The <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/los-angeles-football-club/" >LAFC</a> winger found the opener in the 19th minute, finishing at the back post after Daniel Jebbison flicked Liam Millar's cross across goal.</p>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>Les Rouges doubled the advantage in the 35th minute, when Millar whipped another dangerous cross toward the back post, where Peru goalkeeper Diego Romero got a hand to it but couldn't push it clear. The ball stayed alive for Shaffelburg, who nodded home from close range for his second of the afternoon.</p>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>The victory built on last weekend's <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/canada-beat-chile-to-open-2030-fifa-world-cup-cycle" >1-0 win</a> over Chile in Toronto, giving Marsch's group consecutive wins and clean sheets to open their 2030 <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/competitions/fifa-world-cup/" >FIFA World Cup</a> cycle.</p>

    </div>
  
    <div class="oc-c-body-part oc-c-body-part--text  ">
      <p>Canada now turn their attention to Tuesday's friendly against the <a href="https://www.mlssoccer.com/clubs/us-men-s-national-team/" >United States</a>, their final match of the three-match window.</p>

    </div>
